items.title: Resy Rewards: Earn an additional 4X Membership Rewards points on dining
items.why: Benchmark this Resy-linked earn against our dining offers and check whether a similar reservation-based earn fits our partner pipeline.
items.summary_ai: American Express launched Resy Rewards, offering 4 extra Membership Rewards points on dining reservations paid with an enrolled card.
items.take: Benchmark this Resy-linked earn against our dining offers and check whether a similar reservation-based earn fits our partner pipeline.
